title: rosa micrantha f. lemanii
intro: Rosa micrantha f. lemanii, commonly known as the fragrant rose, is a subspecies of wild rose native to China and India. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa micrantha f. lemanii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's bioactive constituents, including gallic acid and epigallocatechin gallate, contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
